124:t_000:4.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「First, I'll break into the base and pull as much information as I can from a terminal.」

124:t_000:5.en:
$$エマ$$
「The rest of us will hold the line in the meantime. We're to intercept anything that approaches $$ティエリア$$, right?」

124:t_000:6.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I'm leaving $$ティエリア$$'s escort to you, $$刹那$$.」

124:t_000:9.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Are you going to be okay, $n? Sortieing all by yourself...」

124:t_000:12.en:
$n
「The unease you're feeling, Miss $$スズネ$$... I have some idea what it is myself.」

124:t_000:14.en:
$n
「Just as I said in the briefing. ...I'm not the person I was when I trembled in fear anymore.」

124:t_000:15.en:
$n
「Instead of being afraid of something, I'll step forward on my own to overcome it.」

124:t_000:16.en:
$$バナージ$$
「Please leave the backup to us.」

124:t_000:17.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「If he's that fired up, we can't just leave him alone.」

124:t_000:18.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「Looks like your short-straw blood is stirring, $$ロックオン$$.」

124:t_000:19.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「Quit teasing. All of us attempting a breakthrough in a spot this bad are Short Straw Alliance members by now.」

124:t_000:21.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「Even so, I have no intention of ending up in tears.」

124:t_001:0.en:
$$ハサウェイ$$
「That's a huge number of them...!」

124:t_001:1.en:
$$カツ$$
「As expected of the enemy's main base on this continent...!」

124:t_001:2.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Hah hah hah, your will to resist must be withering, you fools!」

124:t_001:3.en:
$$コーラサワー$$
「It's that commander from the other day...!」

124:t_001:4.en:
$$グラハム$$
「To think a man like that is entrusted with command... Perhaps this base isn't that valuable after all.」

124:t_001:5.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Enough of your backtalk! Know that coming strolling into $$セントラル・ベース$$ was the end of your luck!」

124:t_001:6.en:
$$フェルト$$
「The $$アンゲロイ$$ at the front seem to be piloted by $$インセクト$$s!」

124:t_001:7.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「It's certainly a formidable deployment. And on top of that, we have another mission.」

124:t_001:8.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$アーデ$$'s entry point is set! It's that spot over there!」

124:t_002:1.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「Everyone, I'm counting on you for cover!」

124:t_002:2.en:
$$ロックオン$$
「You can count on us!」

124:t_002:3.en:
$$アレルヤ$$
「We'll clear away anything that blocks the breakthrough!」

124:t_002:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If $$ティエリア$$ can't reach the point within 4 minutes, the operation fails!」

124:t_002:5.en:
$$オットー$$
「All units, begin the attack! Hit the enemy force and cover $$ティエリア$$'s breakthrough!」

124:t_002:6.en:
$n
「I'll pull it off...! We're going to win this battle, no matter what!」

124:t_003:0.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「$$アーデ$$ has reached the point!」

124:t_003:1.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「All units, support $$ラファエルガンダム$$! Keep the enemy away until $$ティエリア$$ finishes the cracking!」

124:t_003:2.en:
$$刹那$$
「I'm counting on you, $$ティエリア$$!」

124:t_003:3.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「The Empire's data...! I'll pull it out, no matter what!」

124:t_004:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「I was hit with interference during the cracking...! I can't extract any more data!」

124:t_004:3.en:
$$フェルト$$
「Be careful, $$刹那$$! Something's coming out of the base!」

124:t_006:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The unease I've felt all this time... One of them is...!」

124:t_008:2.en:
$$ティエリア$$
「That's him...! The one who interfered with our cracking is that man!!」

124:t_008:5.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You've got some skill... But...」

124:t_008:6.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Thanks to that, you'll suffer for a long time.」

124:t_009:2.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Exactly, 《$$いがみ合う双子$$》.」

124:t_009:3.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「Now... be consumed by your own hatred.」

124:t_009:7.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「While the $$いがみ合う双子$$ thrash in their hatred, let me finish the introductions.」

124:t_009:8.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My name is $$バルビエル・ザ・ニードル$$...」

124:t_009:9.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I'm the $$スフィア・リアクター$$ of the '$$怨嗟の魔蠍$$'.」

124:t_009:11.en:
$$アムロ$$
「A $$スフィア・リアクター$$, he says...!?」

124:t_009:13.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「I heard you took the $$スフィア$$ from $$ガドライト#pilot$$, so I was looking forward to seeing just how good you are...」

124:t_009:14.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「What a letdown. Just as $$尸空#pilot$$ said, that drunkard is still better than this.」

124:t_009:16.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「You still have your sanity? Tenacity is a trait of the $$いがみ合う双子$$, isn't it.」

124:t_009:17.en:
$$バルビエル$$
「My $$アン・アーレス$$'s venom is working, isn't it? Now you and that ugly machine of yours are finished.」

124:t_010:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$バルビエル$$! I, $$ギルター$$, am coming to you now!」

124:t_011:0.en:
$$ギルター$$
「$$バルビエル$$! I, $$ギルター$$, am coming to you now!」

124:t_012:1.en:
$$ギルター$$
「Not a chance! I won't let you get in $$バルビエル$$'s way!」
